sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: Vollpension heißt Buffet am Morgen, Mittag und Abend. :: Full board means a buffet in the morning, at midday and in the evening. Das Hotel ist mit Vollpension im Preis inbegriffen. :: The hotel with full board is included in the price.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Halbpension is half board: breakfast and dinner.
